title: Wellness Membership Cancellation Terms
content:
A Wellness Membership is cancelled on the member's written notice, within the cooling-off period, before its start, or after it has been past due for the period its tier allows.

## Clauses

**1. Notice.** Cancellation is the member's own decision and takes written notice; the request is registered and takes effect 30 calendar days after the notice date, and dues keep billing until then. Between the notice and the date it takes effect, the membership is pending cancellation. The notice period is 30 calendar days on every tier.

**2. Early-termination fee.** A cancellation taking effect before the commitment end date bills the early-termination fee of the tier, which is waived for a documented move to a residence more than 25 miles from every clinic, or, where the tier provides the medical termination waiver, on a physician's statement that the member can no longer exercise.

**3. Withdrawal.** A notice may be withdrawn before it takes effect; the membership is then active again.

**4. Cooling-off.** Within the cooling-off period the membership is cancelled at once with a full refund. A membership that has not yet started may likewise be cancelled by the member before the start.

**5. After the commitment.** Where the tier continues after the commitment, the membership continues month to month after the commitment.

**6. Past-due memberships.** A past-due membership is cancelled no earlier than 60 calendar days after the past-due date on file. Days are counted as calendar days from the past-due date, the past-due date itself being day zero. The figure is 60 calendar days on every tier, and the past-due date is the one recorded on that membership.

## Dates worked through (hypothetical)

| Event | Date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Written notice given | March 3 | takes effect April 2, 30 calendar days after the notice date |
| Past-due date on file | May 1 (day zero) | June 29 is day 59, too early; June 30 is day 60, the earliest date of cancellation |

## Early-termination fee at a glance

| Cancellation takes effect before the commitment end date | Documented new residence more than 25 miles from every clinic | Physician's statement that the member can no longer exercise | Early-termination fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | any | any | not billed |
| Yes | Yes | any | waived |
| Yes | any | Yes | waived |
| Yes | No | No | billed |

A documented new residence exactly 25 miles from the nearest clinic is not more than 25 miles away, so the relocation waiver does not apply to it.
